# Capacities import fixtures (S5, FR-IMP-23, D-50)

Hand-written, **synthetic** mini exports, one per BRD §15.1 finding. Nothing comes from the real exports. Each folder is an extracted export with space folders (`<Space>/<Type folder>/<note>.md`); the tests select space `PKM`. The zip variants (FR-IMP-07) are built from these folders at test time.

Generated byte-exact; media files are 1×1 placeholders. Tests: the S5 spike's `tests/fixtures_report.rs` (commit `75b3382`, removed by D-1366); the importer, v1.0 (D-801), slice I1, gets its own.

| Finding | Fixture | What it reproduces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C1 several spaces, overlapping type names | `c01-spaces/` | `IDC`, `PKM`, `Work`, each with `Tasks/` and `Pages/`; links from PKM to a Work object by title and by path |
| C2 typed YAML frontmatter | `c02-typed-frontmatter/` | user type `Book` with number, checkbox, select attributes; `ENG`/`eng` select variants; links inside code; one note with broken YAML (skipped and reported) |
| C3 UTC-midnight dates | `c03-utc-midnight-dates/` | `date: '…T00:00:00.000Z'`, a non-midnight date-time, `null` |
| C4 date ranges | `c04-date-ranges/` | `2026-07-01 -> 2026-07-14` and a range of UTC-midnight date-times |
| C5 media objects | `c05-media-objects/` | `Images/*.md` + `Images/Media/*` (URL-encoded diacritics), generic `image (3).png`, unreferenced `Untitled (44).png`, PDF object with a missing preview image, a page embedding the image |
| C6 weblinks | `c06-weblinks/` | folded `>-` URL, `domain`, `iframeUrl`, `previewImage: null` |
| C7 query shells | `c07-query-shells/` | two queries with title and description only |
| C8 tag collections | `c08-tag-collections/` | header-only CSVs, one with a BOM |
| C9 unresolved links | `c09-unresolved-links/` | `[[Date/…]]`, `[[NOTE/<uuid>]]`, a missing title, a missing path link, `status: '[[in progress]]'` |
| C10 duplicate titles | `c10-duplicate-titles/` | two meetings `Tomáš : Eva` (files `… (1).md`), a path link with unencoded parentheses, an ambiguous `[[Tomáš : Eva]]`, three weblinks titled `Article` |
| C11 file names differ from titles | `c11-file-names/` | `11 2026-03-19 Jana.md` titled `1:1 …`, trailing space, `#` and `[ ]`, a Czech title over 200 bytes, relation attribute |
| C12 task dates | `c12-task-dates/` | `date` + `deadline` + `completed`; statuses `Not Started`, `In Progress`, `Done`, `null` |
| C13 daily notes | `c13-daily-notes/` | timestamp lines (`09:15`, `7:05`), `reviewed: true/false` |
| C14 reserved keys | `c14-reserved-keys/` | `source: kniha`, `file: notes.txt` |
| C15 common attributes | `c15-common-attributes/` | `description`, `aliases`, `icon`, `coverImage`, `createdAt`, `lastUpdated` |
| C16 comma-separated people | `c16-comma-people/` | `people: Jana, Tomáš, Eva` |
| C17 invisible characters | `c17-invisible-chars/` | BOM, U+200B in title and body, ZWJ inside an emoji (kept) |
| C18 checklists | `c18-checklists/` | `- [ ]`, `- [x]`, nested, `*` marker |
| C19 AI chat | `c19-ai-chat/` | `type: 'AIChat'` → Page |

## Added for the v1.0 importer ACs (`docs/acceptance/import-capacities.md`, approved 2026-11-12, D-1517…D-1544)

These reproduce spike findings (S5 `FINDINGS.md` F1–F12) and write-phase cases that C1–C19 have no fixture for. Synthetic and hand-written like the rest. The owner decided AP-1310…AP-1343 on 2026-11-12 (D-1517…D-1550); the expected outputs (written vaults, reports) are added by the test author.

| Fixture | For | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `c20-file-name-edges/` | FR-IMP-11 AC-4 (D-80, F10), FR-IMP-10 AC-8 (F9) | a Page titled `CON` (Windows-reserved stem), a Page titled `???` (no valid characters; its export file is `Otazníky.md`), a Person `Tomáš`, and a Page `Odkazy` linking to all three by title. The file is written in NFC: the NFD case is made **at test time** by decomposing `[[Tomáš]]` in a temporary copy (U+0061 U+0301, U+0073 U+030C) |
| `c21-value-variants/` | FR-IMP-08 AC-10, AC-11, FR-IMP-09 AC-5 | three Tasks with `priority` `HIgh` / `High` / `Low`, statuses `Not Started` / `Done` / `In Progress`, `people: Jana, Tomáš` / `Jana` / `null`; People `Jana`, `Tomáš`; two Meetings whose `date` is a UTC-midnight date-time (`Retro`) and the year-less text `Jun 26` (`Porada`) |
| `c22-link-shapes/` | FR-IMP-10 AC-7, AC-9, AC-12 (F1, F12) | a Page `Tvary odkazů` with Markdown links to `Cíl` that a line regex misses or misreads: an image inside a link, link text over two lines, brackets in link text, formatted link text; the same link forms inside a code span and a fenced code block (must stay byte for byte); one external `https://` link |
| `c23-stored-covers/` | FR-IMP-24 AC-2, FR-IMP-15 AC-4 (contract `docs/contracts/v1-import.md` §16.2, §4.1; CP-11 pending) | a stored cover, added with the slice I1 implementation (a new folder, so no other fixture's counts change): a Weblink `Tegg docs` whose `previewImage` is a Markdown image link into `Weblinks/Media/` (`Náhled webu.png`, URL-encoded, a file with no note of its own: it gets a made Image object); a Weblink `Bez náhledu` whose `previewImage` names a missing file (`chybí.png`, the missing case, CP-11); a Page `Zahrada` whose `coverImage` is a Markdown link to `Images/Media/Obal.jpeg`, the file of the Image note `Obal`. Empty bodies. The two media files are copies of `c05-media-objects`' `image (3).png` and `Mapa řeky.jpeg` |
| `x01-not-capacities/` | FR-IMP-07 AC-9 | **not an export**: a folder of plain Markdown notes, none with `type:` frontmatter (one has no frontmatter, one has only `tags:`). The importer must refuse it and write nothing |
| `target-existing-vault/` | FR-IMP-20 AC-2, FR-IMP-03 AC-6…AC-8, FR-HIS-04 AC-12 | **not an export**: a small Tegg vault used as the import **target** (the tests copy `tests/fixtures/vaults/new-empty/.tegg/` into a temporary copy first). `Pages/PKM home.md` carries `import-id: "capacities:PKM/Pages/PKM home.md"` (matches `c01-spaces`); `.trash/Pages/Links across spaces.md` carries a matching `import-id` in the trash; `Tasks/PKM task.md` is the user's own Task with the same file name as an imported one and no `import-id`; `Books/Book 1.md` with `.tegg/types/book.yml` (`author` text, `pages` **text**, `rating` **number**: the target of the refused text → number mapping, FR-IMP-03 AC-8) meets `c02-typed-frontmatter`'s `Book` (`pages` number). `_attachments/Mapa řeky.jpeg` is the user's own attachment, a **text placeholder** with the same name as `c05-media-objects`' image (FR-IMP-14 AC-9: never replaced). `Daily/2026-02-02.md` is the user's Daily Note for a day that `c13-daily-notes` also has, and `Pages/Týden.md` links to that day with `[[2026-02-02]]` (FR-IMP-11 AC-7, D-1546). Ids `01JB5T000000000000000000nn` |

QA follow-up, 2026-11-12: `c02-typed-frontmatter` gained `Books/Book 5.md` and `Book 6.md` (six Books: `medium` has 2 values, `language` 2 after case-folding, both fewer than half of 6), so that D-1526's select rule gives the selects FR-IMP-08 AC-8 expects. This follows **D-1545** (AP-1338, accepted 2026-11-12): the rule stays and distinct values are counted after case-folding.

Built at test time, never committed: zip variants of every folder (FR-IMP-07 AC-1), a zip with a wrapper folder and a single-space export without the space folder (AC-5), a corrupt (truncated) zip, a password-protected zip and a zip with `../` entry names (AC-8, AC-9), `.DS_Store` and hidden `.md` entries (AC-6), CRLF and NFD copies, and the generated 120 MB export for progress and cancel (AC-3).
